How Linear would do this
  • A few inputs, all else worked out. Base, accent, contrast.
  • Live preview as you drag.
  • Shared as one line of colors you can paste.
  • Saved to the account, not the machine.
Where this differs, and why
  • A named Radix pick first, not three free inputs: Radix's steps come with contrast promises, and its docs say not to change them.
  • Shared theme files too. People already have a terminal theme they like, and fabrika is half terminal.
  • Your-turn, stuck, running and done keep their meaning. A pick that lands on one of those colors gets a warning.
  • Line tint is its own control. Linear has nothing like it.

Today's version, a mockup only. The shared themes' values are their real files, read and repaired by experiment 177. Ticket #7's content is the app's stand-in.
